_comment: MATTERCHAT F8 — Firm Console. Keys NOT already present in packages/i18n/src/locales/en.i18n.json. Merge these in when the i18n file is next touched; the console reuses the existing Firm_Invites_*/Firm_Domain_* keys wherever they already exist. Interpolation is Rocket.Chat's __var__ form.
Firm_Console_Load_Failed: We could not load your firm
Firm_Console_Disabled: Firms are turned off on this workspace, so there is nothing to manage here.
Firm_Console_No_Firm: You are not part of a firm yet. Create one, or open the invite link a colleague sent you.
Firm_Console_Readonly_Notice: You can see who is in the firm here. Invite links and email domains are managed by the firm's owner.
Firm_Practice_Areas_None: No practice areas were chosen when this firm was set up.
Firm_Practice_Areas_Unavailable: We could not load this firm's practice areas.
Firm_Practice_Areas_Hint: Practice areas decided which channels were created when the firm was set up. Changing them now would not add or remove channels, so they are shown for reference only.
Firm_Members_Description: Everyone who has joined this firm.
Firm_Members_Empty: Nobody has joined this firm yet.
Firm_Members_Load_Failed: We could not load the firm's members
Firm_Members_Truncated: Showing __shown__ of __total__ members. Use the directory to see everyone.
Firm_Invite_Create_Hint: Everyone you list here is emailed the same link, with the expiry and use limit below. Separate addresses with commas or spaces.
Firm_Invite_Emails_Required: Add at least one email address. A link can only be created by sending it to someone.
Firm_Invite_Created_Hint: Copy this if you would rather send it yourself, or hand it over in person.
Firm_Invites_Empty: There are no live invite links. Invite someone above to create one.
Firm_Invites_Load_Failed: We could not load your invite links
Firm_Domain_Hint: Use your firm's own email domain. Public providers such as Gmail or Outlook cannot be claimed.
Firm_Domain_Required: Enter the domain you want to claim.
Firm_Domains_Empty: No domains claimed. Everyone joins by invite link until you claim one.
Firm_Domains_Load_Failed: We could not load your claimed domains
Firm_Domain_Pending_Explainer: This claim does nothing yet. Nobody joins automatically until the confirmation link in the email we sent is opened.
Firm_Domain_Pending_Explainer_With_Email: This claim does nothing yet. We emailed a confirmation link to __email__ — until someone opens it, signups at this domain will not join the firm.
Firm_Domain_Pending_Expires: The confirmation link stops working on __date__.
Firm_QR_Description: Point a phone camera at this code to install and join without typing a server address.
Firm_QR_Alt: QR code containing this firm's invite link
Firm_QR_Empty: Create an invite link above and a QR code will appear here.
Firm_QR_Unavailable: We could not load an invite link to turn into a QR code.
Firm_QR_Render_Failed: This link is too long to fit in a QR code. Copy it instead.
Firm_QR_Link_Hint: The same link, if it is easier to send than to scan.
Firm_Domain_Verify_Failed: This confirmation link did not work
Firm_Domain_Verify_Missing_Token: This link is incomplete. Open the confirmation link from the email exactly as it was sent.
